text: dsh-self-improved 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的长期记忆与自进化插件。它在会话结束时捕获文本并写入本地 SQLite 记忆库，由后台模型提炼事实、偏好、事件和指令；新回合开始前可检索相关记忆并注入上下文。用户还可以搜索和纠正记忆、整理场景与画像、让重要经验合成为技能，并在 Web 设置页调整模块与查看记忆。默认不需额外配置密钥；向量检索可选配置 embedding 服务。

dsh-self-improved adds long-term memory to the DSH web client. It stores session text locally, extracts facts and preferences, and can inject relevant memories before each turn. Users can search or correct memories, build a persona, and synthesize reusable skills. An embedding endpoint is optional.

希望系统能把零散经历归纳成场景和用户画像。
我想把反复有效的工作流程沉淀成可复用技能。

dsh-self-improved 的功能「对话捕获与记忆提炼」：会话 flush 时保存文本事件切片，后台按会话批量调用模型提取原子记忆，并进行校验、去重和重要度筛选。
dsh-self-improved 的功能「记忆召回注入」：新回合进入 agent/pre-step 时按当前输入查找相关记忆，并将结果作为上下文消息加入模型请求；可用关键词或混合检索。
dsh-self-improved 的功能「记忆工具」：模型可调用 memory_search 搜索结构化记忆，也可查找历史会话原文、纠正记忆或将其标记为遗忘。
dsh-self-improved 的功能「/memory 命令」：用户可通过搜索、列出、纠正或遗忘子命令管理记忆，也可查看状态并手动触发整理。
dsh-self-improved 的功能「场景与画像巩固」：定期将高价值记忆分组总结为场景，并基于记忆和旧版本生成可回溯的新用户画像。
dsh-self-improved 的功能「遗忘与技能合成」：按重要度、新鲜度和使用次数衰减旧记忆，并可将高价值经验整理成可复用技能文件。
dsh-self-improved 默认使用本地记忆库；若配置 OpenAI 兼容 embedding 服务，查询文本和记忆内容会发送到所填端点以生成向量。

dsh-self-improved README · dsh-self-improved：**Long-term memory & self-evolving plugin** for DeepSeek Harness (fully local).

> Status: M0–M6 complete and deployed to a real environment (web profile). Design/research docs stay local only (see `.gitignore`).

dsh-self-improved README · What it is：Adds the two missing capabilities to DSH — "cross-session memory + self-evolution":

- **Memory**: automatically distills key points from conversations (facts / preferences / events / instructions) into a local memory store; before each new turn, relevant memories are injected to the model — the AI "remembers you".
- **Self-evolution**: memories are consolidated, decayed and corrected; successful workflows can be distilled into reusable skills; the user persona keeps evolving with conversations.

dsh-self-improved README · What it is：The architecture follows the four-layer memory pyramid of TencentDB Agent Memory (L0 capture → L1 extraction → L2 scene grouping → L3 persona), but **reuses DSH-native services** (`ctx.llm` / `session` events / `agent/pre-step` injection / `dsh-skill` / `storageDomain`) with a fully local SQLite store (FTS5 + sqlite-vec). No data is uploaded anywhere.

dsh-self-improved README · Roadmap：| Milestone | Scope | Status |
|---|---|---|
| M0 | Probe: event capture / recall injection / tool registration / settings namespace | ✅ Verified (isolated headless) |
| M1 | Memory store: SQLite + FTS5 + jieba + sqlite-vec; L0 capture to disk; memory/search tools | ✅ Verified (unit + headless integration) |
| M2 | Extraction pipeline: `ctx.llm` L1 extraction + strict JSON validation/fallback + dedup + throttled pump | ✅ Unit-tested; running in production |
| M3 | Recall injection: `agent/pre-step` injection + keyword/vector/hybrid retrieval (RRF) | ✅ Unit-tested + end-to-end verified |
| M4 | Self-evolution: L2/L3 consolidation (scenes + versioned persona), decay, correct/forget tools, skill synthesis → dsh-skill | ✅ Unit-tested; synthesized skills in production |
| M5 | UI/ops: settings panel (auto-rendered) + hot runtime toggles + `/memory` command + memory browser | ✅ Complete, deployed to web profile |
| M6 | Growth governance (caps/cleanup) + scheduling (nightly review / free maintenance / startup backfill) | ✅ Complete: governance caps, nightly review (default 22:00), 15-min loop is maintenance-only, master switch stops all timers |

dsh-self-improved README · ⚠️ Install notice: peerDependencies double-instance pitfall (located & fixed)：**Symptom**: after install, **new sessions work but resuming an old session errors** — `deployment:persona already registered`, with a hint "register through that agent's agent.ctx instead".
section: ⚠️ Install notice: peerDependencies double-instance pitfall (located & fixed)

text: dsh-self-improved README · ⚠️ Install notice: peerDependencies double-instance pitfall (located & fixed)：**Root cause (not a plugin bug)**: pnpm's default `autoInstallPeers` installs the plugin's `@deepseek-ai/*` peerDependencies as **physical copies** inside the profile's `node_modules`, creating two independent module instances of the same package as the ones embedded in the dsh main install (e.g. `dsh-scope`). DSH's scoping (preset/persona layers) binds identity via `Symbol("dsh.scope")`; with two instances the persona registration lands in the global layer and collides with the host's `deployment:persona` → resume fails. New sessions happen to succeed because the global layer is not yet occupied on first registration.

dsh-self-improved README · ⚠️ Install notice: duplicate loader entry id (bundle re-mount, instant boot crash)：**Symptom**: dsh **fails to start** (window flashes and closes), and `dsh --profile web --dump-config` shows the same entry `id` twice.

**Root cause**: packages declaring `dsh.bundle` (this plugin since 0.1.1, `dsh-plugin-marketplace`, etc.) are **automatically** added to `dsh.profile.bundles` and their bundled `cordis.patch.yml` inserts one entry; if the profile-level `cordis.patch.yml` **also manually inserts the same id** → the loader throws `duplicate loader entry id` at boot.
section: ⚠️ Install notice: duplicate loader entry id (bundle re-mount, instant boot crash)

text:
dsh-self-improved README · ⚠️ Install notice: duplicate loader entry id (bundle re-mount, instant boot crash)：**Fix (verified)**: reset the profile-level `cordis.patch.yml` to `[]` — bundle assembly is fully owned by `dsh.profile.bundles`; do **not** manually insert bundle plugins at the profile layer.

**Debug tip**: if dsh crashes at startup, run `dsh --profile web --dump-config` and count each entry id; more than one occurrence is this problem.

dsh-self-improved README · $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml：dsh-self-improved:
  enabled: true
  modules:
    capture: true
    extract: true
    consolidate: true
    evolve: true
    recall: true
    tools: true
  review:
    enabled: true      # nightly review (one full evolution per day)
    time: "22:00"      # HH:MM, 24h
```

Notes:

dsh-self-improved README · $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml：- **Master switch off = plugin fully dormant**: all background timers stop (15-min maintenance loop / nightly review / startup backfill), `/memory` and memory tools are unregistered; stored memories are kept and everything resumes when re-enabled.
- **Scheduling**: the 15-minute loop only does extraction + free maintenance (decay/governance, no LLM cost); full evolution (scenes/persona/skills) runs at the nightly review (default 22:00), ~60s after startup, or via manual `/memory evolve`.
- **`/memory` commands are zero-LLM**: they query the local memory store directly; the command declares `input`, so parameterized input is handled by the command system (trigger via the command menu, `/`).
- The memory browser (Settings → "Self-evolving memory" → "Memory" tab) lets you view/filter/correct/forget memories, the persona, scenes and synthesized skills.
